name: District police portals of Khulna Range (Jashore, Satkhira, Meherpur, Narail, Chuadanga, Kushtia, Magura, Bagerhat, Jhenaidah)
organization: Bangladesh Police — district police units of Khulna Range
attribution: District and thana police portals (police.<district>.gov.bd, police.<upazila>.<district>.gov.bd)
notes: No licence stated. SP offices from the Superintendent's officer card; thanas from each upazila's thana portal officer cards (office landline, OC's police official mobile, *.gov.bd e-mail). Personal e-mails, other mobiles and officers' names are not copied. Khulna Range (Range DIG's office, policedig.khulnadiv.gov.bd) covers the 10 districts of the division; Khulna District is in KHULNA_POLICE_2026 and Khulna city's KMP thanas in KHULNA_METRO_POLICE_THANAS_2026. Jashore's police portals are under jessore.gov.bd (police.jashore.gov.bd serves the same site). Thanas that are not upazilas have no portal here.
